Docket 1.3.110

**Docket is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes), $349, or 4 payments of $87.25, to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *Docket keeps a log of how it started.* The app used to start its engine with nowhere
  to write, so if the browser helper Docket uses to read pages that need JavaScript was
  missing or broken, the audit quietly skipped rendering and nothing said so. The engine
  now writes `engine.log` in the `.docket` folder in your home folder. At every start
  it records the version, the licence mode (never the key), whether the free version is
  on, and whether the helper was found and actually runs. It adds a line for each audit
  (the site's host only) and keeps any error the engine prints. The file stays on your
  Mac, is trimmed at half a megabyte and is never sent anywhere. If you write to
  support, it is the file to attach.
- *The build now checks this before it ships.* The installer is opened, the engine inside
  it is started with an empty home folder, and the log must say the helper runs. The same
  engine is then started with a deliberately broken helper, and the log must say so.

99 checks across 13 areas.
